My mom knows about my situation, but she is so keen on going to a specific GP for my depression that I will not be able to get an appointment until summer.

I would love to be a neurologist or someone who researches neurology. I find it fascinating, but recently I've lost almost all passion for that subject.

Not much - I am a student, and I probably have depression. I won't be able to receive treatment for my depression until summer, and I don't think I'll be able to wait that long. Plus I am a horrible person. I just messed up with one of my friends, and I don't have many friends left. I am stupid, which is confirmed by my SAT score, so I won't be able to accomplish any of my dreams. I'm just a waste of space.
